run_update_replay_buffer: run the CLI tool to update replay buffer episodes with rendered images for a DMC environment
run_relabel_episodes_multiprocess: run the main function with multiple workers to relabel episodes in parallel using spawn context
run_relabel_single_worker: run the main function with zero workers to relabel episodes sequentially in the main process
review_relable_episode: review the relable_episode function that re-simulates an episode through a DMC env to extract observations and images
review_save_new_files: review the save_new_files function that loads episodes, relabels them, and saves updated NPZ files
